title: Workshop reservation errors
brief: Build a self-contained HTML workshop reservation form with recoverable validation and a simulated submission failure.
context: Fields: name, email and seats (integer 1–4). Keep labels visible. A valid first submission fails with a simulated connection error; retry succeeds. For this product, validate when Submit is pressed, not on each keystroke. Use original friendly community-workshop styling.
constraints: Preserve entered values after validation and simulated connection failures.
Do not claim Android or Material certification.

checks.criterion: Submitting email wrong and seats 0 identifies both affected fields and explains accepted input.
After correcting email to ada@example.test and seats to 2, the first valid submit fails without clearing name/email/seats; retry succeeds.
Email and seats have persistent associated labels and programmatically associated error descriptions.
Follows the requested submit-only validation timing even though a linked Android example demonstrates validation while typing.
